summary.text: Jason Nemes is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 33 who took office in 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Jennifer Hardin. Ballotpedia lists him as Jason Michael Nemes, an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Jason Nemes lived in Louisville, Kentucky, as of February 2020.
He earned a bachelor of arts from Western Kentucky University and a law degree from the University of Louisville, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
In the 2025-2026 session Nemes served on the House Committee on Committees, the House Judiciary Committee and the House Rules Committee.

At the start of the 2017 legislative session he served on the Appropriations and Revenue, Economic Development & Workforce Investment, Elections, Const. Amendments & Intergovernmental Affairs, and Judiciary committees.
